stem: ![](asset:P000401-stem-1) The two rods AB, BC shown in the given system are of equal length of 3 m. The end A is placed on a roller at the same horizontal plane as end C. If end A is moved with a uniform horizontal velocity of 3 m/s and both rods are at $45{^\circ}$ with the horizontal, then what will be the instantaneous angular velocity of rod BC?
